dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.wing_bar_presence_and_contrast: High-contrast, relatively thick light grayscale fringes are visible across the median and greater coverts, creating multiple distinct horizontal bands.
dorsal_wing_plumage_topography.flight_feather_edge_geometry: Sharp and prominent pale edges are clearly visible along the margins of the folded flight feathers, creating a distinct boundary against the darker interior.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive and highly distinct pale scalloping/fringing on nearly all visible dorsal feathers.
